profile.name: Zaber 串联设备控制组件
profile.description: 用于通过串口管理一组 Zaber 串联设备的非实体控制组件，可统一暴露位移台、滤轮和 LED 控制器等子设备，供显微与实验自动化系统调用。
profile.description_en: A non-physical control component for managing a set of daisy-chained Zaber devices over a serial connection. It exposes child devices such as stages, filter wheels, and LED controllers for microscopy and laboratory automation workflows.
